svg.title: ADBC lockup horizontal construction grid
svg.text: The isometric logomark with the name set like the Apache Arrow wordmark, sized on the logomark’s grid and balanced on its weight.
The logomark’s isometric cells, 10 wide × 10/√3 ≈ 5.77 tall (mark = 110 wide). Rows count down from
the top ring’s hidden top edge. The side corners sit 5½ rows down, so the side walls fall on half rows.
APACHE ARROW in Roboto Regular; ADBC in Barlow Bold at 3 times its cap height, as ARROW is to
APACHE in the Apache Arrow wordmark. Both in capitals, normal kerning, no tracking.
APACHE ARROW’s caps are 3⅓ rows, then 1½ rows of space, under half their height, so the two
lines read as one block, then ADBC’s caps, 10 rows.
The name sits where its centre of weight, the centroid of its ink, is level with the mark’s: rows
12.03 and 12.06. Neither sits high or low against the other, and ADBC’s caps fall on rows
8⅓–18⅓, close to the middle of the mark.
At 3 : 1 both lines come out 201.8–202.2 wide, within 0.2%, so the name is flush left and right.
2 cells between the mark and the name, as wide as a wall is tall. The canvas is rows 0–23,
from the top ring’s hidden top edge, plus half a row all round so no point touches its edge.
